description: This file contains utility functions and variables related to test result handling, DOM manipulation, and logging for a web-based testing framework, with copyright from Google Inc.

methods.name: getSelectValue
methods.description: Retrieves the selected value from a dropdown element.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text content from a URL asynchronously.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with optional type styling to a log element.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles display of an element and updates toggler class.

methods.name: getTracUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL to a Trac browser for a given layout test path.

methods.name: getSortedKeys
methods.description: Returns sorted keys of an object.
